target: UTM-bundled QEMU, AArch64 PCI, one vCPU, disposable writable RedSea VirtIO fixture
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/tosmisc-malformed-redsea-current-qemu.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-raw-redsea-geometry malformed
result: pass: stock DiskCheck completed against the malformed fixture, reported one consistency error, and did not fail the guest
verified: The probe ran against a private copy-on-write disk with a 128-sector writable RedSea fixture.
The root directory is valid and contains BROKENDIR starting at the fixture's last sector with a two-sector extent that crosses the volume boundary.
RawRedSeaMalformedChecks called DiskCheck('D', FALSE, FALSE), observed malformed_diskcheck_errors=1, and asserted it was nonzero.
The probe returned 42 and the final guest zstatus reported failed=0.
limits: This validates a read-only scan only; DiskCheck repair with malformed directory metadata remains untested.
It does not cover directory allocation repair, FAT32, live UTM UI, or physical Raspberry Pi behavior. Cyclic-directory coverage is recorded separately.
